mapper.insert: insert into db_user ( user_id, login_name, passwd, nick_name, tel, email, gender, head_pic, birth_date, introduction, location_addr, graduate_school, permission, input_date, last_mod_date ) VALUES ( #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{loginName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{passwd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nickname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{gender,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{headPic,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birthDate}, #{introduction,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locationAddr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{graduateSchool,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{permission,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inputDate}, #{lastModDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT login_name from db_user where user_id=#{userId}

select user_id userId, login_name loginName, passwd passwd, nick_name nickname, tel tel, email email, gender gender, head_pic headPic, birth_date birthDate, introduction introduction, location_addr locationAddr, graduate_school graduateSchool, permission permission, state state, input_date inputDate, last_mod_date lastModDate from db_user

select user_id userId, login_name loginName, passwd passwd, nick_name nickname, tel tel, email email, gender gender, head_pic headPic, birth_date birthDate, introduction introduction, location_addr locationAddr, graduate_school graduateSchool from db_user where state = '0' and login_name=#{loginName} and passwd = #{passwd}
mapper.update: update db_user SET passwd = #{newPassword} where user_id = #{userId} and passwd = #{oldPassword}
mapper.select: select count(1) from db_user where user_id = #{userId} and passwd = #{passwd}
